curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: identify words with the sounds /k/, /j/, /l/, and /s/ from written texts

interactions.retryHint: Point to the first letter and whisper its sound.

interactions.prompt: Find the written word that begins with /k/.
Which written word begins with the /j/ sound?
interactions.feedback: Yes! Yellow begins with the /j/ sound.
interactions.retryHint: Say yellow slowly; its first sound is /j/.

interactions.prompt: Find the word that contains the /l/ sound at the end.
interactions.feedback: Lovely listening and reading! Ball ends with /l/.
interactions.retryHint: Read to the last sound in each word.

interactions.prompt: Read: “The lion sees a yellow kite.” Which pair has /l/ then /s/?
interactions.feedback: Great text search! Lion has /l/ and sees has /s/.
interactions.retryHint: Search the sentence for /l/ first, then /s/.

interactions.feedback: Sound-search champion! You matched all four sounds.
interactions.retryHint: Check one word and one sound at a time.
